_comment: Paid OpenAI run (proprietary baseline + frontier judge). Use a dedicated project with an ENFORCED hard spend limit. Model IDs and prices: check platform.openai.com/docs/models and the pricing page on the day you run. Newer OpenAI models need token_param=max_completion_tokens and may reject temperature (set it to null). Estimate cost first: python -m src.experiments.estimate_cost.

models._note: proprietary baseline; verify the exact ID on the platform

judge._note: frontier judge; must differ from the baseline model; verify the exact ID
